player_prompt.intro: Waxaad tahay ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ee Nim. Ujeedadaadu waa inaad qaadato shaygii ugu dambeeyay ee haray. Wareeg kasta, dooro saxda ah hal saami oo ka saar mid ama waxyaabo badan. Isticmaal qaabka '[pile quantity]', halka saamiga uu yahay tusmada saamiga iyo tirada waa tirada walxaha la saarayo. Tusaale ahaan, '[0 3]' wuxuu ka saaraa 3 shay oo ka mid ah saamiga 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Wax qaab ah oo sax ah oo la soo helay ma jiro. Isticmaal '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id}, ficil aan ansax ahayn. Tiirka {col} waa ka baxsan yahay.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Liiska saamiga {pile_index} waa ka baxsan yahay.
invalid_move.non_positive: Waa in uu meesha ka saaraa ugu yaraan hal shay.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Kama saari karo {quantity} oo ka soo baxa {pile_index} (kaliya {pile_count} ayaa tagay).

observation.removed_from_piles: Ciyaartoy {player_id} waxa uu ciyaaray [{pile_index} {quantity}], ka saaray {quantity} shay (oo) tuulada {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Ciyaaryahanka {player_id} wuxuu qaatay shaygii ugu dambeeyay ((s)!
